title: Gatekeeper: Rollout playbook + workspace access-audit flow (console)
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Goal: design a single, discoverable ‘Rollout Playbook’ surface in the Redwood Console that guides engineers and admins through permission-safe model rollouts while providing an audit-first record for compliance teams. This ticket pairs that playbook with a redesigned workspace access-audit flow so that every rollout step (canary, throttled burst, fallback) is logged as part of the access timeline and ties back to who changed roles, why, and what cost/latency trade-offs were expected.

Scope: the work includes low-fidelity flows, mid-fidelity interactive prototype (Figma), sample copy for the playbook steps, and an annotation layer that surfaces related cost estimates and affected service routes. The redesign touches: Workspace settings > Access & Roles, Rollouts modal, Audit timeline, and the Rollout Playbook entry point in the model detail page.

Design principles: minimize modal fatigue for admins, make least-privilege effects visible before commit, and surface cost delta estimates for rollout plans so product owners can weigh quality vs spend. All audit entries should be human-readable, tamper-evident, and link to the rollout package for replay/rollback.
comments: 2026-02-22 - Asha: Kickoff notes captured; aligned with PM on scope. Need ENG input on what metadata is guaranteed in audit logs (request IDs, model version, route).
2026-02-27 - Marco: Wireframes added to Figma. Introduced a lightweight step that shows estimated token cost delta for each rollout stage. Asking infra for cost calculator hook (ENG-40912).
2026-03-03 - PM (Sofia Ramos): Suggested adding a mandatory rationale field for role changes during rollouts for compliance. Added to acceptance criteria.

2026-03-07 - Usability testing: 6 participants (platform/ML engineers). Key finding: users wanted an explicit preview of access impact (who loses access, what endpoints become available). Follow-up: add 'Impact preview' card and group by team.

2026-03-10 - Security review (Lewis Chen): flagged that audit entries must include immutable hashes and export capability. Security wants an early spike to validate KMS integration with Private installs. Marked security_review_required = true.

2026-03-12 - Design review: PM and Eng feedback consolidated. Prototype updated with color-blind friendly status indicators and an alternative compact timeline for high-frequency changes. Ready for final QA pass.

acceptance_criteria: 1) Rollout Playbook entry point exists on model detail and workspace settings; 2) Prototype demonstrates canary -> ramp -> fallback steps with clear affordances and cost delta estimates; 3) Access-audit timeline shows each rollout step as a first-class, exportable entry linking to the responsible actor and rationale; 4) Usability test shows >=80% task success for creating a canary rollout and previewing access impact; 5) Security confirms audit export format and immutable markers or KMS plan for Private deployments.
notes:
Trade-offs considered: embedding cost estimates client-side (fast, but approximated) vs server-side calculation (precise, requires infra work). For MVP we show an estimated delta computed from recent token distributions with a tooltip explaining variance.

Future: link this with Optimize recommendations so playbooks can suggest quantized model variants with estimated regression risk.
